abstract: In this paper, we analyse the determinants of maritime connections, with a special focus on the importance of foreign direct investments (FDI) in improving maritime transportation networks and in restructuring them. We are also interested in how China, in particular, impacts countries' integration to global supply chains through maritime transportation. We work on a heterogeneous panel of bilateral maritime connections as measured by UNCTAD's bilateral liner shipping connectivity index, and we find that FDIs between two partner countries do not significantly impact their maritime connection. However, we do find that Chinese FDIs in countries concerned by the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) reinforce bilateral maritime connections between countries, in general, be they BRI countries or not. The Chinese influence is also significant via their maritime presence: maritime connections between two countries are significantly higher when host countries have strong maritime ties to China. A deeper analysis through several interaction effects also shows the Chinese influence is conditional on host countries' attributes. For instance, a maritime connection with China is more beneficial to developing/poorer host countries, who see their connection to origin countries increase more as compared to developed/richer host countries.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了海上连接的决定因素，特别关注外国直接投资在改善海上运输网络及其结构调整中的重要性。我们还重点研究了中国如何通过海上运输影响各国融入全球供应链。基于联合国贸发会议双边班轮航运连接指数衡量的异质性双边海上连接面板数据，我们发现两国之间的外国直接投资并未显著影响其海上连接。然而，中国在“一带一路”倡议相关国家的直接投资普遍加强了各国（无论是否为“一带一路”国家）之间的双边海上连接。中国的海上存在也产生了显著影响：当东道国与中国有紧密的海上联系时，两国之间的海上连接显著更高。通过多种交互效应的深入分析表明，中国的影响取决于东道国的特征。例如，与中国建立海上连接对发展中国家/较贫穷的东道国更为有利，这些国家与来源国的连接提升幅度大于发达国家/较富裕的东道国。

title: Foreign Direct Investment and Maritime Transportation Infrastructure: Competition Effects Under the Belt and Road Initiative
title_zh: 外商直接投资与海上交通基础设施：“一带一路”倡议下的竞争效应

abstract: This study examines the effects of special economic zones (SEZs) on firm growth and the regional business environment in Viet Nam, highlighting their key role as a policy tool to attract foreign investors. Using detailed panel data from Viet Nam’s 63 provinces from 2006 to 2020 and instrumental variables (IV) estimations, this study provides new insights into how SEZs impact firm growth and several dimensions of economic governance. SEZs are found to play a dual role. Provinces with broader SEZ coverage experienced increases in employment, revenues, and the number of foreign-invested enterprises. In contrast, domestic private firms faced declines in both revenues and numbers. SEZ exposure had negative effects on several aspects of provincial economic governance including land access, transparency in policy-making, and informal charges. In addition, the approval of the first SEZ was also associated with increased prevalence of informal charges and preferential treatment of foreign-invested enterprises and other big companies, which may indicate heightened inefficiencies and rent-seeking concerns.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了越南经济特区（SEZs）对企业增长及区域营商环境的影响，凸显其作为吸引外资政策工具的关键作用。基于2006至2020年越南63个省份的详细面板数据，并采用工具变量（IV）估计方法，本研究揭示了经济特区如何影响企业增长及经济治理的多个维度。研究发现，经济特区发挥着双重作用。经济特区覆盖范围更广的省份，其就业、收入及外商投资企业数量均有所增长。相比之下，国内私营企业的收入与数量均出现下降。经济特区的设立对省级经济治理的若干方面产生了负面影响，包括土地获取、政策制定透明度及非正规收费。此外，首个经济特区的获批还与外商投资企业及其他大型企业非正规收费增加及优惠待遇加剧相关，这可能表明效率低下与寻租问题日益突出。
title: The Role of Special Economic Zones in Shaping Viet Nam’s Local Business Environment
title_zh: 经济特区在塑造越南本地商业环境中的作用

abstract: China's accession to the World Trade Organization in 2001 marked the beginning of one of the most consequential episodes in the history of global trade. The subsequent surge in Chinese exports–often referred to as the "China Shock"–has been widely associated with large adjustments in production patterns, labor markets, and trade balances across the global economy (Autor et al. 2016; Pierce and Schott 2016).
abstract_zh: 中国于2001年加入世界贸易组织，标志着全球贸易史上最具深远影响的事件之一的开端。随后中国出口的激增——常被称为“中国冲击”——已被广泛认为与全球经济中生产模式、劳动力市场及贸易平衡的重大调整密切相关（Autor等，2016；Pierce和Schott，2016）。

title: China shock 2.0: How China’s ongoing export surge differs from the early 2000s
title_zh: 中国冲击2.0：中国当前出口激增与21世纪初的差异

abstract: This paper proposes a new framework to study the distribution of current taxes and the effects of tax reforms. For current taxes, labor taxes are assigned to the corresponding workers, capital taxes to the corresponding asset owners, and consumption taxes to the corresponding consumers. Current taxes capture the wedges between pre-tax prices (relevant for production) and after-tax prices (relevant for the work, saving, and consumption decisions of households) as well as the direct equity effects of taxes while being silent about efficiency. Our method does not require structural assumptions, is internally consistent, and maximizes the comparability of tax progressivity and inequality over time and across countries. Applying this methodology to the United States, we find that the effective tax rate of the top 1% has declined from about 50% in the early 1950s to 32% in 2021. It is through the corporate tax that a high degree of tax progressivity was achieved in the middle of the 20 th century. To analyze the distributional effects of tax reforms, mechanical changes in tax liability by income groups and aggregate revenue effects due to household (but not firms’) behavioral responses are sufficient statistics in the neoclassical optimal tax model of Diamond and Mirrlees (1971). The effects of taxes on pre-tax prices at the heart of classical tax incidence analysis are normatively irrelevant.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新框架，用以研究现行税收的分配状况及税制改革的影响。对于现行税收，劳动税归于相应劳动者，资本税归于相应资产所有者，消费税归于相应消费者。现行税收捕捉了税前价格（与生产相关）与税后价格（与家庭的工作、储蓄及消费决策相关）之间的楔子，以及税收的直接公平效应，而未涉及效率问题。我们的方法无需结构性假设，内部一致，并最大化税收累进性与不平等性在时间及跨国间的可比性。将此方法应用于美国，我们发现顶层1%的有效税率已从20世纪50年代初的约50%下降至2021年的32%。正是通过公司税，20世纪中叶实现了高度的税收累进性。为分析税制改革的分配效应，按收入群体划分的税收负担机械变化及因家庭（而非企业）行为反应导致的总体收入效应，在Diamond和Mirrlees（1971）的新古典最优税收模型中构成充分统计量。古典税收归宿分析中关于税收对税前价格影响的核心内容，在规范意义上并不相关。
title: Distributional tax analysis in theory and practice: Harberger meets Diamond-Mirrlees
title_zh: 理论与实践中的分配性税收分析：哈伯格与戴蒙德-米尔利斯

abstract: This paper analyses the role that field of study choices and firm and job characteristics play in explaining gender pay gaps among university graduates at the beginning of their careers. We exploit a unique administrative population-wide dataset for Italy. We find that choices of university majors alone explain about half of the early-career gender pay gap, since women tend to graduate in fields that give access to lower-paying firms and jobs. Sorting across firms and jobs conditional on premarket specialization only accounts for 20% of the gap, indicating that its role is largely mediated by field choices made while still in education.
title: The origins of the gender pay gap: Education and job characteristics
title_zh: 性别薪酬差距的起源：教育与工作特征

abstract: This paper evaluates a socio-emotional skills training programme for 4,728 urban Tanzanian youth who were not in full-time employment, education, or training. A randomized design compared awareness (for example, self-awareness, empathy, and active listening), management (for example, self-control, personal initiative, and negotiation), and combined curricula. Socio-emotional skills were measured using self-reported and behavioral indicators. Training increased self-reported socio-emotional skills in the short run across both domains, but had limited effects on behavioral measures, and all socio-emotional skills gains faded after one year. Modest but sustained employment gains were observed among men who were job seekers at baseline. Training did not improve labor market outcomes for women. No differential effects were found across training types, and each training affected skills in the alternative domain, suggesting that socio-emotional skills domains are interrelated. These findings indicate that socio-emotional skills training may improve labor market outcomes only for specific subgroups, particularly in the absence of complementary interventions tackling barriers to employment.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了一项针对坦桑尼亚4,728名未处于全职就业、教育或培训状态的城市青年的社会情感技能培训项目。采用随机设计，比较了认知（例如自我认知、同理心和积极倾听）、管理（例如自我控制、个人主动性和谈判）以及综合课程的效果。社会情感技能通过自我报告和行为指标进行测量。培训在短期内提高了两个领域的自我报告社会情感技能，但对行为指标的影响有限，且所有社会情感技能的提升在一年后均消失。在基线时为求职者的男性中观察到适度但持续的就业改善。培训未能改善女性的劳动力市场结果。不同培训类型之间未发现差异化效应，且每种培训均影响了另一领域的技能，这表明社会情感技能领域相互关联。这些发现表明，社会情感技能培训可能仅对特定亚群体改善劳动力市场结果，尤其是在缺乏解决就业障碍的补充干预措施的情况下。

title: Gender and Goals Matter for Youth Employment: Returns to Socio-Emotional Skills Training in Tanzania
title_zh: 性别与目标对青年就业的重要性：坦桑尼亚社会情感技能培训的回报

abstract: Zimbabwe’s land reform was initiated at independence in 1980 to redress deeply unequal colonial land ownership patterns and advance socio-economic justice. However, its outcomes remain contested and unevenly understood across a fragmented body of scholarship. This study therefore undertakes a systematic review of peer-reviewed research from 1980 to 2026, examining the evolution of scholarly engagement, the policy trajectory across reform phases, and the multidimensional impacts of land reform. The review shows that while redistribution expanded access to land and reconfigured agrarian structures, its outcomes have been differentiated and conditional. Social and livelihood patterns reveal the emergence of “middle farmers” alongside the continued marginalisation of vulnerable groups, including women and youth. Environmental evidence points to both adaptive land use and persistent ecological pressures. Across phases, the effectiveness of reform has depended less on redistribution itself and more on institutional capacity, policy coherence, and post-settlement support. By integrating dispersed scholarship within a coherent analytical framework, the study demonstrates that land reform functions as a foundational but insufficient condition for agrarian transformation, with outcomes shaped by the interaction between access to land and broader governance systems.
abstract_zh: 津巴布韦的土地改革始于1980年独立之际，旨在纠正殖民时期极度不平等的土地所有权格局，并推动社会经济正义。然而，其成果在零散的研究文献中仍存争议，且理解程度参差不齐。为此，本研究对1980年至2026年间经同行评审的研究进行了系统性回顾，考察了学术参与的演变、各改革阶段的政策轨迹以及土地改革的多维影响。综述显示，尽管再分配扩大了土地获取机会并重构了农业结构，但其成果呈现出差异化和条件性特征。社会与生计模式揭示了“中等农民”群体的兴起，同时妇女和青年等弱势群体持续被边缘化。环境证据表明，既存在适应性的土地利用方式，也面临持续的生态压力。在各阶段中，改革的有效性更多取决于制度能力、政策连贯性和安置后支持，而非再分配本身。通过将分散的学术成果整合于一个连贯的分析框架内，本研究证明，土地改革是农业转型的基础性条件，但并非充分条件，其成果受土地获取机会与更广泛治理体系之间相互作用的影响。
title: An assessment of Zimbabwe's post-independence land reforms
title_zh: 津巴布韦独立后土地改革评估

abstract: This study examines how changes in forest cover in rural Poland are related to socioeconomic development and the degree of deagrarianization of local economies. Understanding these relationships is essential for the design of effective land-use and afforestation policies in structurally diverse rural regions. The analysis was conducted at the level of local administrative units (LAU), covering all rural municipalities in Poland during 2004–2013, a period of intensive forest expansion supported by the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP). During the study period, Poland’s forest area increased from 28.7% to 29.3%. Private forests accounted for 80.5% of this increase, indicating that agricultural land-to-forest transitions were the dominant source of new forest area. Using generalized additive models, we identified distinct non-linear relationships between afforestation intensity and key socioeconomic indicators. Forest cover growth was strongest in municipalities with low levels of socioeconomic development and a dominant agricultural function. The effect of deagrarianization was threshold-based: afforestation intensity increased with the deagrarianization index up to approximately 0.3, beyond which no further increase was observed. abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了波兰农村森林覆盖变化与当地社会经济发展及经济去农业化程度之间的关系。理解这些关系对于在结构多样化的农村地区制定有效的土地利用和造林政策至关重要。分析在地方行政单位（LAU）层面进行，覆盖了2004—2013年间波兰所有农村市镇，这一时期在共同农业政策（CAP）支持下森林面积快速扩张。研究期间，波兰森林面积从28.7%增加到29.3%。私有林占这一增量的80.5%，表明农地转林地是新增森林面积的主要来源。利用广义加性模型，我们识别出造林强度与关键社会经济指标之间显著的非线性关系。森林覆盖增长在社会经济发展水平较低且以农业功能为主的市镇中最为强劲。去农业化的影响具有阈值效应：造林强度随去农业化指数上升而增加，直至约0.3，此后不再进一步增加。在空间上，森林扩张集中于边缘市镇，尤其是那些远离区域中心且以相对单一功能为特征的地区。
title: Deagrarianization and socioeconomic drivers of forest cover change in rural Poland
title_zh: 波兰农村地区去农业化与森林覆盖变化的社会经济驱动因素

abstract: Do export demand shocks affect firms’ investments in R&D? In this paper, I argue that corruption levels in firms’ countries of origin matter for answering that question. I develop a theoretical model, which predicts that if the overall impact of an export demand shock is positive, innovations of firms from non-corrupt states will increase more than those of firms from corrupt states. If the overall impact is negative, R&D investments of firms from non-corrupt states will decline less than the investments of firms from corrupt countries. The model predicts that it can also be possible for R&D investments of firms from corrupt countries to decline/stay the same, but the investments of the ones from non-corrupt states to go up, but not vice versa. To test these predictions empirically, I construct a measure of corruption using data from three non-governmental organizations and employ firm-level data covering firms from different countries. The empirical results suggest that, on average, manufacturing firms from non-corrupt countries invest around 7.8 times more into R&D than the ones from corrupt states. Moreover, an increase in the export market size is found to be positively associated with R&D investments of manufacturing firms originating from non-corrupt states. In most empirical specifications, I find a negative statistical association between the R&D investments of manufacturing firms from corrupt countries and the increase in the export market size.
title: Exports, corruption and innovation
title_zh: 出口、腐败与创新

abstract: Climate-induced extremities deplete agricultural yield and reshape investment incentives. Mitigating the adverse effects of climate change on food systems requires increasing commitments to climate-smart investments (CSIs). Property Rights (PRs) create incentives to utilize resources optimally. However, unless such rights are enforceable, CSIs may remain low. In this study, we specifically interrogated the role of institutions in strengthening or undermining the resilience of food systems by assessing how different land-use rights (formal, semi-formal and informal) impact farming households’ incentives to embrace climate-smart adaptation measures. Data for this study were obtained from the fifth wave of the General Household Survey (GHS) Panel for Nigeria. Data from 1199 farming households were analyzed using the Endogenous Switching Regression (ESR) model. Our results show that holding formal PRs have higher positive correlates with investments in climate-smart adaptation measures than in the counterfactual scenario, and, farming households without such rights exhibit higher positive correlates with investments in climate-smart adaptation measures than in the counterfactual scenario. By contrast, residence in communities that allocate non-formal (semi-formal and informal) PRs significantly improves the CSIs of farming households than in the counterfactual scenario. However, the positive impact on CSIs is significantly lower for farming households in communities that do not allot non-formal PRs than in the counterfactual scenario. Therefore, extending the frontier of non-formal PRs such that communities that hitherto do not wield such rights become empowered to allot them is a core pathway through which institutions in Nigeria can foster extensive commitments to climate-smart adaptation measures among farming households.
abstract_zh: 气候引发的极端事件降低了农业产量，并重塑了投资激励。缓解气候变化对粮食系统的不利影响，需要加大对气候智能型投资（CSIs）的承诺。产权（PRs）为优化资源利用创造了激励。然而，除非这些权利具有可执行性，否则气候智能型投资可能仍然较低。在本研究中，我们通过评估不同土地使用权（正式、半正式和非正式）如何影响农户采纳气候智能型适应措施的激励，专门探讨了制度在增强或削弱粮食系统韧性中的作用。本研究数据来源于尼日利亚第五轮综合住户调查（GHS）面板数据。采用内生转换回归（ESR）模型对1199个农户的数据进行了分析。结果表明，与反事实情景相比，持有正式产权的农户在气候智能型适应措施投资方面表现出更高的正向相关性；而没有此类权利的农户在气候智能型适应措施投资方面也表现出比反事实情景更高的正向相关性。相比之下，居住在以非正式（半正式和非正式）产权分配土地的社区中，农户的气候智能型投资显著高于反事实情景。然而，对于居住在未分配非正式产权的社区中的农户，其对气候智能型投资的积极影响显著低于反事实情景。因此，扩展非正式产权的边界，使迄今未拥有此类权利的社区能够获得分配权，是尼日利亚制度促进农户广泛参与气候智能型适应措施的核心途径。
title: Heterogenous impacts of property rights on the climate-smart investments of farming households: Empirical evidence from Nigeria
title_zh: 产权对农户气候智慧型投资的异质性影响：来自尼日利亚的经验证据

abstract: In this study, we develop quantitative models to identify land use changes to individual parcels in Miami, FL. We focus on indicators for changes in population and economic activity. In our analysis, we identify the factors that promote this activity by examining how residential and commercial parcels are changing over time. While significant efforts have been conducted in earlier literature, there is limited work on understanding how parcels of a particular land use type change over time. The main aim of the proposed research effort is to contribute to land use evolution models that are customized by land use type. These frameworks can allow for quantitative exploration mechanisms for policy makers to proactively encourage sustainable adaptation due to emerging challenges associated with global climate change. The frameworks were developed using high-resolution parcel level data from the Florida Department of Revenue for the time period 2011–2020. The framework has two components: (1) a binary logit model to analyze what factors affect a change from the current land use designation and (2) for parcels selected for a change, a multinomial logit model, to examine the factors contributing to the new land use type. We built a joint model system that allows for a simultaneous estimation of the two decision processes. The joint model was estimated using a comprehensive set of independent variables including socio-demographic variables, economic development variables, and transportation infrastructure variables. The models developed were validated using hold-out sample data to show the value of the proposed model system
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们开发了定量模型，以识别佛罗里达州迈阿密市个别地块的土地利用变化。我们重点关注人口和经济活动变化的指标。在分析中，我们通过考察住宅和商业地块随时间的变化，识别促进这种活动的因素。尽管早期文献中已有大量研究，但针对特定土地利用类型地块随时间变化的理解工作仍然有限。本研究的主要目标是贡献于按土地利用类型定制的土地利用演化模型。这些框架能够为政策制定者提供定量探索机制，以主动鼓励因全球气候变化带来的新兴挑战而进行的可持续适应。这些框架是利用佛罗里达州税务局2011年至2020年间的高分辨率地块级数据开发的。该框架包含两个组成部分：（1）一个二元Logit模型，用于分析哪些因素影响当前土地利用指定状态的变化；（2）对于被选中发生变化的土地地块，一个多项Logit模型，用于考察促成新土地利用类型的因素。我们构建了一个联合模型系统，允许对两个决策过程进行同时估计。该联合模型使用了一组全面的自变量进行估计，包括社会人口变量、经济发展变量和交通基础设施变量。所开发的模型通过保留样本数据进行了验证，以展示所提出的模型系统的价值。
title: Understanding land use evolution for vacant residential and vacant commercial parcels in Miami, Florida
title_zh: 理解佛罗里达州迈阿密市闲置住宅与闲置商业地块的土地利用演变

abstract: Economic and political decisions are increasingly made in international organizations (IOs). A distinctive feature of many IOs is that they operate under a system of rotating leadership (e.g. a committee chair that rotates annually). Despite the widespread use of such systems and their potential value to interest groups, we know surprisingly little about how interest groups respond to rotating leadership in IOs. Using both micro- and macro-level data on the economic performance of commercial lobbyists in the European Union, I show that interest groups respond strategically to short-term shifts in leadership. Specifically, when a country takes over the rotating EU Council Presidency, interest groups increase their use of commercial lobbyists to gain access to policymakers from the presiding country.
abstract_zh: 经济与政治决策越来越多地在国际组织（IOs）中作出。许多国际组织的一个显著特征是，它们采用轮值领导制度（例如，委员会主席每年轮换）。尽管这种制度被广泛采用，且对利益集团具有潜在价值，但我们对利益集团如何应对国际组织中的轮值领导制度知之甚少。利用欧盟商业游说者经济表现的微观与宏观层面数据，我揭示了利益集团会策略性地应对短期领导权更迭。具体而言，当一个国家接任欧盟理事会轮值主席国时，利益集团会增加对商业游说者的使用，以获取与主席国政策制定者接触的渠道。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Lobbying and rotating leadership
title_zh: 游说与轮值领导

abstract: Robo-advisors are tools in financial markets that provide investors with low-cost financial advice, typically based on individual characteristics such as risk attitudes. We study the benefits of robo-advice in a ten-week portfolio choice experiment. Depending on treatment, investors either receive robo-advice, have a robo-advisor implement recommendations by default, or invest on their own. While we observe no effect of robo-advice on initial market participation, we find positive effects on continued participation. Robo-advisors also help investors avoid mistakes, increase rebalancing, and yield portfolios closer to the utility-maximising benchmark. Default implementation of recommendations performs significantly better than advice alone.
abstract_zh: 机器人投顾是金融市场中为投资者提供低成本财务建议的工具，通常基于风险态度等个人特征。我们通过一项为期十周的投资组合选择实验，研究了机器人投顾的益处。根据实验处理方式的不同，投资者或接受机器人投顾建议，或由机器人投顾默认执行推荐方案，或自行投资。虽然我们未观察到机器人投顾对初始市场参与的影响，但发现其对持续参与具有积极效应。机器人投顾还能帮助投资者避免错误、增加再平衡操作，并使投资组合更接近效用最大化的基准水平。相较于仅提供建议，默认执行推荐方案的效果显著更优。
title: On the Benefits of Robo-Advice in Financial Markets
title_zh: 论机器人投顾在金融市场中的益处

abstract: Savings behavior is governed by innate predispositions (nature) and environmental conditions (nurture); yet prior research largely examines these forces in isolation. Leveraging China’s send-down movement—a policy shock that exposed urban youths to adversity—and a twins design exploiting genetic differences between monozygotic and dizygotic pairs, we identify nature-nurture interplay. Applying extended twin-based variance components models to representative data, we find that adversity more than triples genetic influence on savings, increasing its variance share from 15.2 percent among the unexposed to 53.4 percent among the exposed. Results challenge conventional fixed-effects models which assume time-invariant unobserved traits (e.g., genetic endowments) exert linearly additive effects, and demonstrate policy effectiveness hinges on interactions with such traits.
abstract_zh: 储蓄行为受先天禀赋（天性）与后天环境（教养）共同支配，然而既有研究多将二者割裂分析。本研究借助中国"上山下乡"运动——一项使城市青年暴露于逆境的政策冲击——结合双胞胎设计（利用同卵与异卵双胞胎的遗传差异），识别天性-教养的交互作用。通过将扩展的双胞胎方差成分模型应用于代表性数据，我们发现逆境使储蓄行为的遗传影响提升逾两倍，其方差占比从未经历逆境群体的15.2%跃升至经历逆境群体的53.4%。该结果挑战了传统固定效应模型（该模型假设未观测特质如遗传禀赋呈线性可加效应），并证明政策有效性取决于其与这类特质的交互作用。

title: How Nurture Activates Nature in Determining Savings Behavior: Evidence from China’s Send-Down Movement and Twins Data
title_zh: 后天如何激发先天以决定储蓄行为：来自中国上山下乡运动与双胞胎数据的证据

abstract: The cultivation of economic resilience in poverty-stricken areas is often constrained by capital shortage and development path locking. While existing studies primarily examine resilience through industrial composition and upgrading, the role of industrial land use structure as a spatially embedded and institutionally mediated dimension of economic organization remains underexplored. Based on data from 756 Chinese poverty-stricken counties (2010–2020), this study employs the shift-share model and XGBoost-SHAP method to examine the nonlinear and heterogeneous relationships between structural adjustment of industrial land use and economic resilience. The adopted methodological framework further uncovers threshold effects and nonlinear patterns that are difficult to detect using linear approaches. The results exhibit pronounced heterogeneity across land use types: a high concentration of resource-intensive industrial land is associated with lower economic resilience, reflecting potential technology lock-in; adjustments in capital-intensive industrial land exhibit an inverted U-shaped relationship with resilience; and higher shares of labor- and technology-intensive industrial land are consistently associated with stronger resilience, likely through employment expansion and knowledge spillovers. These findings demonstrate that industrial land use structure provides a complementary analytical lens by linking land allocation, factor mobility, and development path dependence. By highlighting the differentiated and policy-conditioned associations between industrial land use structure and economic resilience, this study offers insights into resilience-building strategies for poverty-stricken regions.
abstract_zh: 贫困地区经济韧性的培育往往受制于资本短缺与发展路径锁定。现有研究主要从产业构成与升级视角考察经济韧性，而工业用地结构作为经济组织在空间嵌入与制度中介维度上的重要体现，其作用尚未得到充分探讨。基于2010—2020年中国756个贫困县的数据，本研究采用偏离-份额模型与XGBoost-SHAP方法，考察工业用地结构调整与经济韧性之间的非线性及异质性关系。所采用的方法框架进一步揭示了线性方法难以识别的门槛效应与非线性模式。研究结果在用地类型间呈现出显著异质性：资源密集型工业用地的高集中度与较低的经济韧性相关联，反映出潜在的技术锁定效应；资本密集型工业用地的调整与经济韧性呈倒U型关系；劳动密集型与技术密集型工业用地占比的上升则始终与更强的经济韧性相关，其作用机制可能源于就业扩张与知识溢出。上述发现表明，工业用地结构通过联结土地配置、要素流动与发展路径依赖，为经济韧性研究提供了互补性的分析视角。通过揭示工业用地结构与经济韧性之间差异化且受政策条件调节的关联，本研究为贫困地区韧性建设策略提供了启示。

title: Structural adjustment of industrial land use and economic resilience: Evidence from China's poverty-stricken counties
title_zh: 工业用地结构调整与经济韧性：来自中国贫困县的证据

abstract: While land tenure security is recognised as a cornerstone of sustainable land use, understanding of its influence on the adoption of agroecological practices is still limited, particularly in tenure-insecure contexts. This study examines how land tenure security, institutional support, and behavioural factors shape smallholders’ willingness to adopt agroecological innovations. Institutional and behavioural perspectives are integrated within a discrete choice modelling framework to analyse data from a choice experiment conducted with 400 smallholder farmers in Huambo Province, Angola. Willingness-to-accept (WTA) estimates were derived for key attributes, including land tenure security, technical assistance, and financial compensation. A conditional logit model was first employed to establish baseline preferences, followed by a mixed logit specification that relaxes the independence of irrelevant alternatives assumption and captures unobserved preference heterogeneity. The results revealed trade-offs among incentives, with required compensation increasing from 27,250 kwanzas for biopesticide use to 81,749 kwanzas for combined agroecological practices. Secure land tenure emerged as the most influential determinant, reducing WTA by 344%, while behavioural factors, including pro-environmental attitudes and livelihood security perception, moderate farmers’ responses to policy incentives. Overall, the findings indicate that institutional support, particularly tenure security combined with targeted technical assistance, increases adoption and reduces reliance on monetary compensation. These results provide empirical evidence that land governance reforms embedded in supportive institutional frameworks can enhance the cost-effectiveness and scalability of agri-environmental and payments for ecosystem services (PES) programmes. The study offers policy-relevant insights for land-use and agricultural policy design in Sub-Saharan Africa and other regions facing comparable institutional constraints.
abstract_zh: 尽管土地保有权保障被视为可持续土地利用的基石，但其对农业生态实践采纳的影响仍认识有限，尤其是在保有权不稳定的情境下。本研究考察了土地保有权保障、制度支持和行为因素如何塑造小农户采纳农业生态创新的意愿。在离散选择建模框架内整合制度与行为视角，分析在安哥拉万博省对400名小农户进行的选型实验数据。针对关键属性（包括土地保有权保障、技术援助和经济补偿）推导出接受意愿（WTA）估计值。首先采用条件Logit模型建立基准偏好，随后采用混合Logit模型放宽无关选择独立性假设并捕捉未观测到的偏好异质性。结果显示激励之间存在权衡，所需补偿从生物农药使用的27，250宽扎增至综合农业生态实践的81，749宽扎。土地保有权保障成为最具影响力的决定因素，使WTA降低344%，而行为因素（包括亲环境态度和生计安全感知）则调节了农户对政策激励的响应。总体而言，研究结果表明，制度支持，尤其是保有权保障与针对性技术援助相结合，能够提高采纳率并减少对货币补偿的依赖。这些结果提供了实证证据，表明嵌入支持性制度框架中的土地治理改革能够增强农业环境及生态系统服务付费（PES）项目的成本效益和可扩展性。本研究为撒哈拉以南非洲及其他面临类似制度约束地区的土地利用和农业政策设计提供了具有政策相关性的见解。
title: Land tenure security and agroecological transitions: Evidence from a discrete choice experiment in Angola
title_zh: 土地权属保障与农业生态转型：基于安哥拉离散选择实验的证据

abstract: We investigate the impacts of industrial parks on economic growth, living standards, and women’s empowerment in Ethiopia. Exploiting the staggered openings of parks across districts and combining satellite imagery with detailed survey data, we document several key findings. First, the establishment of an industrial park leads to sizable gains in local economic activity and urbanization. However, these effects remain spatially concentrated, with little evidence of spillovers into nearby districts. Second, parks situated in areas with stronger market access, larger labor pools, and better transport connectivity generate substantially larger impacts, underscoring the importance of location fundamentals. Third, the arrival of a park improves local living standards and raises employment rates — particularly among women — reflecting the parks’ predominant focus on female-labor-intensive industries. This shift enhances women’s decision-making power and reduces their acceptance of domestic violence, suggesting meaningful progress toward female empowerment.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了工业园区对埃塞俄比亚经济增长、生活水平及女性赋权的影响。利用各区工业园区分阶段设立的情况，结合卫星影像与详细调查数据，我们记录了若干关键发现。首先，工业园区的建立显著促进了当地经济活动与城市化进程。然而，这些效应在空间上高度集中，几乎没有证据表明存在向邻近地区的溢出效应。其次，位于市场准入更佳、劳动力规模更大及交通连接更优区域的工业园区，其影响显著更大，凸显了区位基础条件的重要性。第三，工业园区的到来改善了当地生活水平并提高了就业率——尤其是女性就业率——这反映了园区主要集中于女性劳动密集型产业的特点。这一转变增强了女性的决策权，并减少了她们对家庭暴力的接受度，表明在女性赋权方面取得了实质性进展。

title: The socioeconomic impacts of industrial parks in Ethiopia
title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚工业园区社会经济影响研究

abstract: We study optimal bailout policies amidst banking and sovereign crises. Our model features sovereign borrowing with limited commitment, where domestic banks hold government debt and extend credit to the private sector. Bank capital shocks can trigger banking crises, prompting the government to consider extending guarantees over bank assets. This poses a trade-off: Larger bailouts relax financial frictions and increase output, but increase fiscal needs and default risk (creating a ‘diabolic loop’). Optimal bailouts exhibit clear properties. The fraction of banking losses the bailouts cover is (i) decreasing in government debt; (ii) increasing in aggregate productivity; and (iii) increasing in the severity of banking crises. Even though bailouts mitigate the adverse effects of banking crises, the economy is ex ante better off without bailouts: Having access to bailouts lowers the cost of defaults, which in turn increases the default frequency, and reduces the levels of debt, output, and consumption.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了银行危机与主权危机并存时的最优救助政策。模型设定中，主权借款面临有限承诺约束，国内银行持有政府债务并向私营部门发放信贷。银行资本冲击可能引发银行危机，促使政府考虑对银行资产提供担保。这构成了权衡：更大规模的救助虽能缓解金融摩擦并提升产出，但会增加财政需求及违约风险（形成“恶魔循环”）。最优救助政策具有明确特征：救助覆盖银行损失的比例（i）随政府债务增加而下降；（ii）随总生产率提高而上升；（iii）随银行危机严重程度加剧而上升。尽管救助缓解了银行危机的不利影响，但事前而言，无救助的经济状况更优：救助的可获得性降低了违约成本，进而提高了违约频率，并减少了债务、产出和消费水平。
title: Optimal bailouts in banking and sovereign crises
title_zh: 银行与主权危机中的最优救助

abstract: This paper explores the relationship between geographic mortality differentials and human capital investment patterns in the Malthusian setup of 19th-century Armenia. We examine how variations in altitude are associated with mortality rates, human capital accumulation, and fertility decisions. Using detailed historical census and parish records, we document that higher-altitude areas tend to have lower population density, lower respiratory disease mortality, and lower overall mortality. Our empirical analysis also shows that individuals in these environments tend to display better numeracy skills and lower fertility rates. These findings align with the Ben-Porath hypothesis, suggesting that longer life horizons encourage shifting from child quantity to quality. Furthermore, these patterns are not driven by income differences or increased female autonomy arising from pastoral agriculture.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了19世纪亚美尼亚马尔萨斯式环境下，地理死亡率差异与人力资本投资模式之间的关系。我们研究了海拔变化如何与死亡率、人力资本积累及生育决策相关联。利用详细的历史人口普查和教区记录，我们发现高海拔地区往往具有较低的人口密度、较低的呼吸系统疾病死亡率以及较低的总体死亡率。实证分析还表明，这些环境中的个体通常表现出更好的计算能力和较低的生育率。这些发现与Ben-Porath假说一致，表明更长的生命预期鼓励从子女数量向质量的转变。此外，这些模式并非由收入差异或牧业农业带来的女性自主权增强所驱动。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Geographic mortality differentials and the quality-quantity trade-off
title_zh: 地理死亡率差异与质量-数量权衡

abstract: We estimate the effect of local regulatory approval times on housing production. The analysis derives from a novel dataset of development timelines for all multifamily housing projects permitted by the City of Los Angeles between 2010 and 2022. Results indicate that a 25 percent reduction in approval times would have increased the rate of housing production in Los Angeles between 2010 and 2022 by 12.7 percent, simply by pulling forward in time the completion of projects already begun. The production gains are even larger upon accounting for the role of approval times in incentivizing new development. Discretionary approvals are shown to be especially salient to development timelines. The estimated impacts on development are also shown to be heterogeneous across project type and space, and correlated with neighborhood socioeconomic status. Results underscore the importance of municipal regulatory reform to the achievement of housing production goals.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了地方审批时间对住房建设的影响。分析基于一项新颖的数据集，涵盖了2010年至2022年间洛杉矶市批准的所有多户住宅项目的发展时间线。结果表明，审批时间缩短25%，仅通过提前完成已启动项目的时间，就能使洛杉矶在2010年至2022年间的住房建设率提高12.7%。在考虑审批时间对激励新开发项目的作用后，生产收益更为显著。自由裁量审批对发展时间线的影响尤为突出。估计对开发的影响在项目类型和空间上表现出异质性，并与社区社会经济状况相关。研究结果强调了市政监管改革对于实现住房建设目标的重要性。
title: Development approval times and new housing supply: Evidence from Los Angeles
title_zh: 开发审批时间与新房供给：来自洛杉矶的证据

abstract: The fracking revolution has exposed more than 15 million American residents to drilling within 3 miles, a tripling from conventional extraction methods. While the economic benefits are distributed across nearby counties, the environmental and neighborhood costs are concentrated within miles of a well. Using granular data on exposure and outcomes, I show that nearby fracking activity shrinks neighborhood population by 5%. The spatial decay, temporal pattern, and mechanisms of this treatment effect operate to debunk the stylized argument that fracking creates local boom towns.
abstract_zh: 水力压裂革命已使超过1500万美国居民暴露于3英里范围内的钻井活动，这一数字是传统开采方法的三倍。尽管经济效益分布于邻近各县，环境和社区成本却集中在油井数英里之内。利用关于暴露程度和结果的精细数据，我表明附近的压裂活动使社区人口缩减了5%。这一处理效应的空间衰减、时间模式及其作用机制，共同驳斥了压裂创造地方繁荣城镇的典型论点。
title: Fracking ghost towns: How neighborhood exposure drives population decline
title_zh: 压裂鬼城：社区暴露如何驱动人口下降

abstract: The existing literature shows that women are generally more likely than men to pay taxes. However, there is less consensus on gendered responses to interventions designed to boost compliance among non-payers, and the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. In this study, we exploit a field experiment designed to increase property tax compliance to investigate this gender disparity. Because female- and male-led households differ along many dimensions, including preferences, household structure, and economic resources, we interpret the female–male contrast as the joint product of these channels rather than the effect of gender alone. Within this framing, the cross-sectional baseline gap in compliance is descriptive, while the within-gender treatment effects of the experimental messages are causally identified by random assignment. Our findings confirm that taxpayers in female-led households are more diligent in paying taxes than those in male-led households at baseline. Notably, while receiving a deterrence letter encourages women to pay earlier, it does not increase their overall compliance; men, in contrast, show a marked improvement in overall compliance upon receiving the same letter. We also find that the size of the tax bill influences women’s compliance behavior (the likelihood of payment after treatment rises significantly for smaller tax bills) but has no similar effect on men. Survey data targeted at the same population suggest that, although women may be more motivated to pay (they perceive higher enforcement risk and exhibit higher tax morale) they also face tighter liquidity constraints, lower and less stable income, and a stronger perception that the tax is excessive. These patterns are consistent with a simple analytical model that links compliance to tax morale, risk aversion, and budget constraints, and in which liquidity-constrained taxpayers remain at a corner solution unresponsive to enforcement messages. The findings highlight how tax policies and enforcement procedures can exacerbate post-tax income inequality between genders, particularly in low-enforcement contexts where the tax base is weakly correlated with current income.
abstract_zh: 现有文献表明，女性通常比男性更倾向于纳税。然而，关于旨在提高未缴税者合规性的干预措施是否存在性别差异反应，学界尚未达成共识，其潜在机制仍不明确。本研究利用一项旨在提高房产税合规性的实地实验，探究这一性别差异。由于女性主导家庭与男性主导家庭在偏好、家庭结构及经济资源等多个维度存在差异，我们将男女对比解读为这些渠道共同作用的结果，而非单纯性别效应。在此框架下，横截面基线合规差距属于描述性分析，而实验信息在性别内部的处理效应则通过随机分配实现因果识别。研究结果证实，在基线水平上，女性主导家庭的纳税人比男性主导家庭更勤于纳税。值得注意的是，虽然收到威慑信函会促使女性提前缴税，但并未提高其整体合规率；而男性在收到相同信函后，整体合规率显著提升。我们还发现，税额大小影响女性的合规行为（小额税单处理后支付概率显著上升），但对男性无类似效应。针对同一人群的调查数据表明，尽管女性可能更有纳税动机（她们感知到更高的执法风险并表现出更强的纳税道德），但同时也面临更紧的流动性约束、更低且不稳定的收入，以及更强烈的税负过重感知。这些模式与一个将合规性关联至纳税道德、风险规避及预算约束的简单分析模型一致，在该模型中，受流动性约束的纳税人处于角点解状态，对执法信息无反应。研究结果凸显了税收政策与执法程序如何加剧性别间的税后收入不平等，尤其是在税基与当前收入弱相关的低执法环境中。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Willing but unable to pay? Gender, preferences, resources, and tax compliance
title_zh: 愿意但无力支付？性别、偏好、资源与税收遵从

abstract: This paper establishes a precise link between the tail behavior of a distribution and the structure of its Virtual Value. We show that the only continuously differentiable distributions whose Virtual Value is linear on an interval coincide, on that interval, with a Generalized Pareto distribution. This equivalence yields explicit expressions for optimal cutoffs and implies that, within this class, comparative statics of allocation and pricing rules are governed by a single primitive, the tail index. Thin tails lead to the familiar monotone adjustment of prices, whereas heavy tails reverse the sign of the response and produce countercyclical pricing. The analysis also demonstrates that widely used textbook distributions acquire an approximately affine Virtual Value in their upper tails whenever their expectations are finite. Under standard regularity conditions from Extreme Value Theory, the tail Virtual Value converges to an affine form, with slope equal to the underlying tail index. These results provide a unified framework for studying allocation, mechanism design and monopoly pricing in environments where high valuations play a central role.
abstract_zh: 本文在分布的尾部行为与其虚拟价值结构之间建立了精确联系。我们证明，唯一在某一区间上具有线性虚拟价值的连续可微分布，在该区间上与广义帕累托分布一致。这一等价关系为最优截断值提供了显式表达式，并意味着在此类分布中，配置与定价规则的比较静态分析由单一原始参数——尾部指数——所支配。薄尾分布导致熟悉的单调价格调整，而厚尾分布则使响应符号反转，产生逆周期定价。分析还表明，当期望有限时，广泛使用的教科书分布在其上尾部分近似具有仿射虚拟价值。在极值理论的标准正则条件下，尾部虚拟价值收敛于仿射形式，其斜率等于潜在尾部指数。这些结果为研究高估值起核心作用的环境中的配置、机制设计与垄断定价提供了统一框架。
title: Affine Virtual Values and the Generalized Pareto distribution
title_zh: 仿射虚拟值与广义帕累托分布

abstract: How will future climate change affect Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) in terms of migration and welfare? Can policymakers help SSA adapt to this process? I answer these questions with a quantitative framework that, coupled with rich spatial data and forecasts for the future climate, projects millions of climate migrants and unequal welfare losses across SSA. Investigating migration and trade liberalization as policy tools, I find persistent inequality in welfare losses if only migration barriers in SSA are reduced. Relaxing trade barriers addresses these distributional concerns, as do both policies combined. Yet, the policy mix is less effective in reducing aggregate losses due to inefficiencies arising from congestion externalities.
abstract_zh: 未来气候变化将如何影响撒哈拉以南非洲地区的移民与福利？政策制定者能否帮助该地区适应这一过程？本文通过构建一个量化分析框架，结合丰富的空间数据与未来气候预测，揭示了撒哈拉以南非洲地区将出现数百万气候移民及不均衡的福利损失。在将移民与贸易自由化作为政策工具进行研究时发现，若仅降低撒哈拉以南非洲地区的移民壁垒，福利损失的不平等现象将持续存在。放松贸易壁垒能够解决这些分配问题，而两项政策组合实施亦能达到同样效果。然而，由于拥挤外部性导致的效率损失，政策组合在减少总体损失方面的有效性有所降低。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: Climate Change and Migration: The Case of Africa,
title_zh: 气候变化与移民：非洲案例研究

abstract: Stock markets play a dual role: they provide information about firms’ fundamentals, which improves resource allocations, and they provide liquidity. We propose a setting in which these two roles interact: if stocks are used more intensively for liquidity, then prices reveal less information about fundamentals. We structurally estimate stock price informativeness for several countries and show that it declines when alternative liquidity sources, such as banks, are in distress. To study the real effects of this mechanism, we devise a strategy to integrate our stock-trading module into a dynamic general equilibrium model with heterogeneous firms. We calibrate the model to the US and simulate recessions with and without banking distress. In a stand-alone recession, prices become more informative, and allocation improves, mitigating output losses by 4.4%. If the recession coincides with banking distress, agents rely more on stock markets to obtain liquidity, prices become less informative, and allocation deteriorates, magnifying output losses by 22%.
abstract_zh: 股票市场具有双重作用：一方面提供企业基本面信息以优化资源配置，另一方面提供流动性。我们构建了一个两种作用相互影响的框架：若股票被更密集地用于获取流动性，则价格所反映的基本面信息将减少。我们通过结构估计测度了多国股票价格的信息含量，发现当银行等替代性流动性来源陷入困境时，股价信息含量会下降。为研究该机制的实际经济效应，我们设计策略将股票交易模块嵌入包含异质性企业的动态一般均衡模型。基于美国数据校准模型后，我们模拟了有无银行业困境伴随的经济衰退情景。在独立衰退中，价格信息含量提升，资源配置改善，使产出损失降低4.4%；若衰退伴随银行业困境，经济主体将更依赖股票市场获取流动性，导致价格信息含量下降与资源配置恶化，使产出损失扩大22%。
title: Business, Liquidity, and Information Cycles
title_zh: 商业、流动性与信息周期

abstract: Editor's Note Our policy is to annotate all English-language books on economics and related subjects that are sent to us. A very small number of foreign-language books are called to our attention and annotated by our consulting editors or others. Our staff does not monitor and order books published; therefore, if an annotation of a book does not appear six months after the publication date, please write to us or the publisher concerning the book.
abstract_zh: 编者按 本刊政策是对所有寄送至我处的经济学及相关领域的英文书籍进行评注。少量外文书籍会由特约编辑或其他人士提请关注并予以评注。本刊工作人员不负责监控及订购已出版书籍；因此，若某本书在出版日期六个月后仍未出现评注，请就该书事宜致函本刊或出版社。
title: Annotated Listing of New Books
title_zh: 新书注释目录

abstract: The categories listed below are used to classify books, book reviews, journal articles, and dissertations indexed in JEL and EconLit. New changes to the classification system appear as soon as possible on www.econlit.org . The JEL classification system may be used freely for scholarly purposes. We suggest the following format: “JEL: A10, B10, etc.”
abstract_zh: 以下类别用于对JEL和EconLit中收录的书籍、书评、期刊文章及学位论文进行分类。分类体系的新变更将尽快在www.econlit.org上公布。JEL分类体系可自由用于学术目的。建议采用以下格式：“JEL: A10, B10, 等”。
title: JEL Classification System for Books
title_zh: 书籍的JEL分类体系
